title: To Us a Child of Hope Is Born
description: To Us a Child of Hope Is Born in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Morison wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 155.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: To us a Child of hope is born, To us a Son is given, And on His shoul-der ev-er rests All power in earth and heaven.

lines: To us a Child of hope is born,
To us a Son is given,
And on His shoulder ever rests
All power in earth and heaven.
His name shall be the Prince of Peace,
On judgment and on justice based,
His reign shall have no end.
Lord Jesus, reign in us, we pray,
Who with the Father ever art

licence: Public domain: John Morison died in 1798.
credits: Words by John Morison (1750–1798), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
